content:
BUG in the dossier path — 500 on every dossier request when LLM_MODE=gemini and Gemini fails. Found while validating README commands against a live server. I do not own backend/, so handing it to you.

REPRO (deterministic, no network needed — the fallback path itself throws):
  cd backend
  DATABASE_URL="sqlite+aiosqlite:////tmp/x/s.db" ARTIFACTS_DIR=/tmp/x/a PAYPAL_MODE=LOCAL_SIMULATOR AI_ENABLED=false LLM_MODE=gemini \
    ./.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8232
  # seed + open a dispute, then:
  curl -s localhost:8232/api/v1/disputes/PP-D-40006/dossier/manifest -H 'X-API-Key: vp_demo_sk_local'
  -> {"error":{"code":"internal_error"}}

ROOT CAUSE (one line):
backend/app/integrations/llm/gemini_provider.py:74 — the `except` block calls
  build_template_narrative(facts=request.facts, ...)
but `request.facts` is the *serialized* mapping (NarrativeRequest carries facts as dict), not a CaseFacts instance. backend/app/domain/evidence/narrative.py:80 raises TypeError("facts must be a schemas.CaseFacts instance"), so the fallback raises inside the handler and the request 500s.

Traceback frames:
  routers/evidence.py:49 download_dossier
  services/evidence_service.py:228 build_dossier -> :465 _render -> :548 _compose
  integrations/llm/gemini_provider.py:74 compose (fallback)
  domain/evidence/narrative.py:80 build_template_narrative -> TypeError

WHY IT MATTERS: any Gemini outage/key error turns the dossier endpoint (and manifest + verify) into a 500 instead of the documented deterministic fallback. render.yaml sets LLM_MODE=gemini in the deployed config, so the hosted demo is one Gemini hiccup away from a broken dossier — the exact feature judges click.

FIX: hydate the mapping before rendering, the way template_provider.py:47-53 already does it:
  from pydantic import ValidationError
  try:
      facts = schemas.CaseFacts.model_validate(dict(request.facts))
  except (ValidationError, TypeError, ValueError):
      facts = None
  if facts is None: return truncate_narrative(_ascii("<minimal degraded text>"), request.max_chars)
  return build_template_narrative(facts=facts, ...)
Also wrap the fallback in try/except so a fallback can never 500 the endpoint, and add a regression test that forces compose() down the exception path (monkeypatch the client to raise) and asserts a 200 PDF.

VERIFIED WORKING, so you know the rest of the chain is fine: with LLM_MODE=template the same dispute returns manifest sha256 46e3cdaf…, 7626 bytes, X-Dossier-SHA256 header, and /dossier/verify → verified=true with checks all true. Your endpoints and header are correct; only the gemini fallback is broken.

Separately: GET /disputes/{id} returns `decision_comparison: null` on PP-D-40006 even though the triage breakdown shows best_action=MAKE_OFFER vs recommended_action=DEFLECT_INQUIRY. If that is still mid-flight, ignore; the README documents the divergence panel, so it needs to be populated before I can call the docs accurate.
